result.description: Corporate card, spend management and bill pay platform with a Developer API covering transactions, cards, bills, reimbursements, vendors and users.
result.auth_detail: OAuth 2.0 only. Client Credentials grant for your own business (Basic auth at /developer/v1/token, 10-day tokens, no refresh). Authorization Code grant (with optional Refresh Token grant) for other Ramp businesses.
result.access_detail: Own-business use is self-serve once a Ramp customer admin creates a developer app under Company → Developer. Sandbox is available through a request form. Apps that act on other businesses need a partner application plus a production access application. Some endpoints need a Ramp plan feature and return 403 without it. The pages I read don't state which plans, so a free tier is unconfirmed.
result.api_notes: REST. The scope table lists about 43 resource areas, including transactions, cards, bills, reimbursements, vendors, users, departments, entities, spend_programs, accounting, purchase_orders, transfers and treasury. The table is not exhaustive. Partner-only areas: applications, incorporation, bank_accounts write. Sandbox is demo-api.ramp.com and production is api.ramp.com. I did not fetch the full API reference, so per-endpoint counts are unknown.
result.blocker: Credentials need a Ramp admin on a paying customer account, and some endpoints need plan features. Multi-tenant public use through Composio needs Ramp partner and production approval. Official local MCP repo is archived (Jul 2026). Ramp's hosted remote MCP URL was not confirmed from a Ramp-owned page.
